finom-vovk-base.description: Vovk.ts essentials — ALWAYS load first for any Vovk.ts task, including building a back end or API in a project that has vovk.config.* or .vovk-schema/. Holds what a typical build needs, checked against vovk 4's code - project layout, a complete endpoint, how requests, validation and errors behave, status codes, a custom error format, CORS, and how to get the schema, the typed client and the OpenAPI document. The other vovk:* skills go deeper on one topic each; load them only for that topic.
